title: The Devotional and the Practical
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett discusses the need for a more adaptable and individualized approach to Zen practice in the modern world, acknowledging that traditional monastic training may be losing its relevance due to issues such as ableism, gender binary assumptions, and stress related to food and body image. They argue that this requires a shift towards creating schedules and practices that prioritize flexibility, personal space, and individual needs, rather than adhering strictly to traditional models. By embracing this adaptability, practitioners can cultivate greater understanding, compassion, and wisdom in their own unique paths to enlightenment.
